title: How can I handle the grading logic in AI system.
author: Select-Enthusiasm394
selftext: Hi,  We are currently developing an AI-powered language tool specifically designed for real-time conversations in specific contexts.Our biggest challenge lies in the scoring mechanism. Even if the user’s input passes all the grammar and spelling checks perfectly, it may contain phrases that a native speaker would not actually use in that context. If the AI confirms such sentences as “correct” there is a risk that users will develop inappropriate conversational habits. Conversely, if the AI marks them as “incorrect,” it disrupts the flow that is intended to be an engaging, personalized conversational experience.In our current process, we are using PyTorch to build our training system, and Tripo AI to create scenarios and AI characters.Do any of you use a two system, one model to simulate the conversational flow and a separate one for evaluation, Do you use a lightweight model? How do you manage to provide constructive feedback on phrases without turning an engaging conversation into a boring grammar quiz?love to hear how you all handle these types of system adjustment rules.
